name: Meta

capex_guidance.sentence: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $125-145 billion, increased from our prior range of $115-135 billion.

summary: Meta raised its 2026 capital expenditure outlook, including principal payments on finance leases, to $125-145 billion from $115-135 billion, citing higher component pricing and, to a lesser extent, additional data center costs to support future year capacity.
